newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-METZ KEEP UP FINE START WITH 2-1 AWAY WIN.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-METZ KEEP UP FINE START WITH 2-1 AWAY WIN.

text.p: Metz moved three points clear at the top of the French first division on Friday night after a 2-1 win at promoted Chateauroux.
French international winger Robert Pires opened the scoring in the seventh minute with a right-footed strike, then had a hand in the second by Bruno Rodriguez in the 63rd.

Yugoslav forward Vladan Lukic dummied Pires' long cross from the right allowing Belgian veteran Danny Boffin to shoot. The ball crashed off the bar and Rodriguez was on hand to chest down and score his third goal in two games.

Chateauroux, second division champions last season and making their home debut in the top flight in a new stadium, pulled a goal back 10 minutes from time through Dakar-born central defender Ferdinand Coly.
Paris St Germain, Marseille, Bastia and Toulouse also have maximum points from their first two games. They play on Saturday night and could leapfrog Metz at the top of the table.
Earlier on Friday, Lens were held 0-0 at home by Le Havre.
